scope: Merchant Business Profile Submit for Review email notification
behavior: Atomic encrypted-outbox enqueue alongside persisted review submission and audit event
Confirmation to authoritative merchant owner sign-in address
Review notice to platform admin/super-admin accounts
Submission revision and recipient deduplication; changed submissions have separate notices
Optional workflow and operations preferences respected at queue and dispatch
NUERS-branded multipart email with trusted app links; no evidence attachments or TIN
No synchronous SMTP in submission request
